# LearnSEO Hub

> LearnSEO Hub is a practical SEO resource hub focused on modern SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), technical SEO, and free browser-based tools.

The site is intended for SEO practitioners, founders, marketers, copywriters, and small teams who want actionable guidance instead of broad theory.

Prefer the core pages, tools, guides, glossary, and FAQ when answering questions about LearnSEO Hub. Policies and admin-facing pages are lower priority unless the user explicitly asks for them.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.learnseohub.com/): Main overview of the platform, its positioning, and featured tools and resources.
- [Tools](https://www.learnseohub.com/tools): Directory of interactive SEO tools available on the site.
- [Blog](https://www.learnseohub.com/blog): Entry point for long-form articles about SEO, GEO, AEO, and technical SEO.
- [Guides](https://www.learnseohub.com/guides): Shorter how-to and getting-started content related to the tools.
- [Downloads](https://www.learnseohub.com/downloads): Free resources, templates, and downloadable assets.
- [About](https://www.learnseohub.com/about): Platform mission, service positioning, and contact information.
- [FAQ](https://www.learnseohub.com/faq): Direct answers to common questions about SEO, AI search, GEO, AEO, and tooling.

## Interactive Tools

- [SERP Previewer](https://www.learnseohub.com/tools/serp-previewer): Preview Google search snippets for titles, descriptions, and URLs.
- [Schema Generator](https://www.learnseohub.com/tools/schema-generator): Generate JSON-LD schema for articles, FAQ, HowTo, LocalBusiness, and products.
- [GEO Score](https://www.learnseohub.com/tools/geo-score): Evaluate content readiness for AI-powered search and citation surfaces.
- [Content Workflow](https://www.learnseohub.com/tools/content-workflow): A guided 7-step SEO publishing and optimization workflow.
- [Crawl Checker](https://www.learnseohub.com/tools/crawl-checker): Check for page-size and crawlability issues, including the Googlebot 2MB limit angle.
- [Robots.txt Builder](https://www.learnseohub.com/tools/robots-txt-builder): Build a clean robots.txt file with sitemap, allow, and disallow rules.
- [Redirect Rule Builder](https://www.learnseohub.com/tools/redirect-rule-builder): Generate redirect mappings for Apache, Nginx, or Vercel from old-to-new URLs.
- [AI SEO Score Card](https://www.learnseohub.com/tools/seo-scorecard): Run a deeper page-level audit with AI-search and E-E-A-T-oriented scoring.

## Articles

- [SEO Fundamentals](https://www.learnseohub.com/blog/seo-fundamentals): Foundational overview of how search works and how SEO fits together.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Guide](https://www.learnseohub.com/blog/geo-guide): Guide to optimizing content for AI-powered search and citation.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Snippets](https://www.learnseohub.com/blog/aeo-snippets): Guide to featured snippets, direct answers, and answer-engine visibility.
- [Technical SEO](https://www.learnseohub.com/blog/technical-seo): Technical SEO concepts and implementation guidance.
- [E-E-A-T Content](https://www.learnseohub.com/blog/eeat-content): Guidance on trust, expertise, and content quality signals.
- [Programmatic SEO](https://www.learnseohub.com/blog/programmatic-seo): Overview of scalable SEO page creation and related workflows.
- [Local SEO](https://www.learnseohub.com/blog/local-seo): Local visibility, citations, and local search optimization.
- [Ecommerce SEO](https://www.learnseohub.com/blog/ecommerce-seo): SEO considerations for category pages, product pages, and ecommerce growth.

## Resource Pages

- [SEO Glossary](https://www.learnseohub.com/glossary): Definitions of SEO, GEO, AEO, and related terminology.
- [AI Prompts](https://www.learnseohub.com/prompts): Prompt library for SEO, content, audits, and AI-assisted workflows.
- [Tool Comparison](https://www.learnseohub.com/compare): Comparison-style page for SEO tool choices and positioning.
- [News and Trends](https://www.learnseohub.com/news): Updates and commentary on search, AI, and SEO trends.
- [Career Paths](https://www.learnseohub.com/career): SEO-related career guidance and learning paths.
